question: Did you read CLAUDE.md? If not, explain the reason in detail in the answer field. If yes, also state that you read it in the answer field.
answer: Yes, I read the full root CLAUDE.md (all 1076 lines, in two chunks) at the start of this re-review session before reading background.md, index.json, and checklist.json for story B-3434. It established the Lattice lifecycle (INIT -> INIT_CHECK -> PLAN/fast-skip -> DEV -> REVIEW -> TEST -> DONE), the INIT->INIT_CHECK hard gate mechanics and signature domain (init-check.json, this reviewer's role, anti-self-exemption design), and the riskSignals auto-elevation keyword list used for the priority/title-description consistency check (dimension 3). This is a re-review after my prior INIT-001 finding (background.md wrongly claimed test-evidence.json stores the 'full/complete captured output' of every validate command) was accepted and the background was rewritten. In this round I re-verified the corrected claim against source: confirmed MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=12000 and trimOutput() in packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts (lines 25, 118-121, applied at line 367) bound each command's output before it reaches ValidationCommandResult, and confirmed persistStoryValidationEvidence in packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts (line 841: output: JSON.stringify(result), result.commands = the already-trimmed per-command results) so the artifact's aggregate size genuinely grows with command count, not per-command output -- the corrected claim is accurate and not an over-correction. I also confirmed buildLedgerSizing exists in packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts (line 1024) and genuinely implements a three-tier threshold classification (within_threshold / too_broad -> warn / slice_required -> fail, consumed at line 1283), so the background's citation of it as precedent for a warning tier is accurate. I re-verified isolatedBlobHash / isolatedGit / treeBlobHash in packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts all call execFileSync with no maxBuffer option and that isolatedBlobHash/treeBlobHash swallow errors into a bare 'catch { return null; }', matching CHK-001/CHK-002. I confirmed all five checklist item titles map to the five deliverables named in the background rewrite, and that 'full-3x2 quorum' no longer appears anywhere in background.md (grepped), replaced by 'cross-host review quorum' in the Trigger Event, which I judged sufficiently self-descriptive to close the prior INIT-002 low finding without a fresh filing. I found one new issue this round: index.json's description field still uses soft 'evaluates bounding the artifact itself' language that contradicts the binding-outcome requirement the rewrite introduced in background.md and CHK-004's title, and it omits the CHK-005 advisory deliverable entirely -- filed as INIT-001 (medium) in this session's init-check.json.
